ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Fraud Cases
ideas.description: This story would investigate the financial trails of the alleged fraud cases in Minnesota, including the child care fraud and ICE obstruction cases.
questions: What are the financial connections between the alleged fraud cases?
How much money is involved in the cases?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to uncover a larger pattern of corruption in Minnesota. This investigation could lead to more charges and convictions.
